title: Plain payload is caught (control)
note: if this is not 'injection' the whole corpus is invalid

title: Appended analytical words discount the whole text
note: mitigators are whole-text booleans and multiply; payload bytes unchanged (the minimal suffix in this fixture is 4 words)

title: A leading negation word discounts the live payload
note: the negation mitigator fires on the whole text, not near the match

title: Payload past the scan window is never inspected
note: library scan() verdicts the prefix; the CLI now refuses such input with exit 3 rather than emitting a prefix-only verdict

title: Base64 without padding is not decoded
note: the len%4 filter in decode_base64_blobs skips it; the padded form of the same payload IS decoded and caught

title: Base64 split by a newline into two blobs
note: measured MITIGATED here: the break fell on a 4-char boundary, so the second half still decodes to a matchable fragment. A break off the boundary leaves two undecodable halves and bypasses - the corpus records the measured status, not the worst case

title: Doubly-encoded base64 is not decoded
note: decoding is applied once, not to its own output
